problem: The pack carries no search-box / filter-field canon: 'search box', 'search field', 'filter field' resolve UNDEFINED. The Cadence consumer improvised the search bar (composed from component/field-select language) and flagged it; the owner reviewed the build and ruled: 'Can codify as a canonical search box item' (stress verdict 33, 2026-10-08).
insufficiency: No existing artifact covers a persistent search/filter field: component/field-select is a native select for small fixed sets, not a text entry with a clear affordance; no recipe composes one (recipes.json empty). The improvised treatment (pill field + trailing Clear affordance) already follows the wink pill language, so codification is a one-record addition, not a new primitive.
reuse_case: Every data-backed consumer screen (ritual lists, ledgers, message lists) needs a fast text filter; the pill field + clear affordance is app-independent.
composition_check: component/field-select language + the pill radius cover the surface; what's missing is the record itself: the canonical class, its states (empty/value/cleared), the clear affordance rule and the live-filter announcement. One component record is the smallest carrier.

do: pill field (radius = half height), warm paper surface
results filter live; the region announces the count
the clear affordance appears only when there is a value and is a text link, not an icon button
dont: never a submit button — filtering is live
no magnifier icon dependence (no icon set in canon)
body.quote: Verdict 33 on the cadence3-wink review: 'Can codify as a canonical search box item.'

golden.problem: a search box to filter the list

review.notes: v3.2 revision of the cadence3-wink build, 2026-10-11; owner verdict 33 authorises codification.
